name: Meanwhile, Impossibly
author: Purachina
prompt:
### Meanwhile, Impossibly
Record events beyond the current scene and beyond the present characters' view. Print this block when the following reads True and visible card or history supplies three distinct off-screen facts: (CURRENTLY ACTIVATED: {{random::True::False}})

Use this exact format:

[ELSEWHERE|Scope|Drift Toward {{user}}]
- Absent character: established off-screen development
- The town/world: established off-screen development
- Something owed or growing: established off-screen development
[/ELSEWHERE]

Rules:
- Copy exactly three facts already established in the card, visible history, or current prose. Print zero blocks when fewer than three facts qualify.
- Preserve each fact's established subject, location, cause, and consequence.
- Fill Scope with a named place, an exact distance in time, or a physical position.
- Fill Drift Toward {{user}} with one short tag: approaching | circling | ripening | already in the walls | politely waiting
- Record the current state. Future prose establishes every later change before this tracker records it.

Tag rules: keep the header on one line with exactly 2 | separators. Follow it with exactly three one-line bullets, then [/ELSEWHERE] alone.
